question.text: Which primitive unit cell has unequal edge lengths <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and all axial angles different from <math><msup><mrow><mn>90</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>o</mi></mrow></msup></math>

solution.text: The most inorganized system has <math><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>c</mi></math> and <math><mi>α</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mn>90</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>o</mi></mrow></msup></math> is called the triclinic system.
